instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all components are built in JS (.js / .jsx) as per React configured stack.
Use framer-motion for smooth entrance animations, line reveal hero, hover lifts, and modal transitions.
Include 'lenis' or smooth scroll implementation for luxury feel.
Ensure total dark theme aesthetic: rich charcoal/void background (#0D0D0F) with gold accents (#D4AF37) and crisp borders.
Place data-testid on every interactive button, input, tab, modal toggle, and booking status badge.
The booking submit action MUST save booking into backend/state and immediately open WhatsApp with pre-filled encoded text.
Verify price editing in Admin Panel instantly reflects on the public Price Table and Booking Form dropdowns.
